title: Inventory Value appears in the reports navigation under the Parts group
refs: SV-8668 (IV spec Story 1 S1-R1 — access = the one ordinary reports permission per Chris Ward Q2=A + QA lead 2026-08-03 "ONE permission FOR NOW")
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. Your role has the ordinary reports access.
custom_steps:
1. Open the reports navigation.
2. Look inside the Parts group of reports.
3. Click the "Inventory Value" entry.
custom_expected:
1. The reports navigation lists a report labeled "Inventory Value" under the Parts group.
2. Clicking it opens the Inventory Value report.
